verdict.rationale: x402 verifies and screens the *payment* (signed payment proof, OFAC/KYT checks on wallet addresses) but has no mechanism for merchants to identify or tier *agents* themselves — no registered agent profiles, agent-level signatures/identity credentials, or trust tiers are described; the protocol is explicitly designed for signup-free, pseudonymous access ('No signups or approvals required'), the opposite of verifiable agent identity.
